The gear ratio between the two joints. If it is 1, they will both move in opposite directions by the same amount. If -1, they'll move the same amount but in the same direction. Use numbers larger or smaller than 1 to make them move by different amounts relative to each other
A gear joint is a special joint that connects two joints so they move together. They must be either rotating or follows path joints (one of each works too).
The amount of force to push/pull from the center point

Absolute: always apply the same force. Relative: the direction of the force rotates with the rotation of the force zone. Center push: Bodies will be pushed away from the center point of the force zone. Center pull: Bodies will be pulled into the center point of the force zone.
If checked, this force zone will apply its force to arrows.
If checked, this force zone will apply its force to other platforms.
If checked, this force zone will apply its force to players.
Use negative numbers for up, and positive for down. The Y component of the force that is applied every frame to the body that touches this force zone.
The X component of the force that is applied every frame to the body that touches this force zone.
If this is checked, this body will not collide with things. Instead, when other things touch it, they will have a force applied to them
If this is checked, players can fly.
Indicate what mode this map has been designed for. This is just to indicate to players what mode you designed it for, it does not affect which hot list your map will be shown in.
If this is checked, players will respawn when they die. Games must be won by capturing cap zones.
If this is checked, players won't collide.
The size of the map, relative to players. Place some spawns down before changing this to see the effect it's having.

Turn this on to increase the accuracy of the physics calculations. If you are stacking lots of free moving objects on top of each other, this will help to prevent them from collapsing inside each other, and it will help prevent objects from slowly moving through gaps they shouldn't fit through. This increases lag, so only use it if your map doesn't work without it.

If you are having issues with this platform passing through other platforms at high speed, or other platforms moving at high speed passing through this one, turn on Anti Tunneling to prevent it from happening. This increases lag, so only use it where it's necessary.

Higher priority spawn points will be used to spawn players before lower priority spawn points. For example if there are 3 red spawn points with priorities 100, 50 and 10, and there are two red players, they will randomly spawn at the points with priority 100 and 50.
Choose which players will spawn at this point.
Players spawning at this point will start with this Y velocity
Players spawning at this point will start with this X velocity
The Y position of the spawn point.
The X position of the spawn point.
The size of the snap grid, make sure to turn it on with the grid button in the top left.

When set to a normal cap zone, players will touch the cap zone to gradually capture it and win the game, either individually or as a team. Instantly win cap zones will instantly win the game for one team. These instant team cap zones aren't triggered by players, but by other platforms touching the cap zone.
How long in seconds this spawn point will take to be captured.

Capture zones use pre existing shapes to set their boundaries. Select the shape that this capture zone will use. You can use any shape on your map, so it can be a single shape in a stationary body, or a shape that's part of a complex, moving platform.
How much torque to constantly apply to this platform, to cause it to spin.

Absolute: The Apply X and Y Force values are absolute, so X is always left/right and Y is always up/down.
Relative: X and Y are relative to the angle of the platform itself. You can use this to create objects that behave like rockets, accelerating in the direction they are facing.
How much force to constantly apply to this platform, in the Y axis. Gravity is 20, so set this to -20 to make it float.
How much force to constantly apply to this platform, in the X axis.
Set this to Yes to force this platform to always stay at the same angle. If this platform is involved in a rotation joint, fixed rotation won't work.
How much this platforms rotation slows down over time, even if it doesn't collide with anything.
How much this platforms movement slows down over time, even if it doesn't collide with anything.
The rotational velocity this platform starts with.
The Y velocity this platform starts with.
The X velocity this platform starts with.
Which collision groups this platform will collide with.
The collision group this platform belongs to. You can put platforms into categories, and then set any platform not to collide with those categories.

Whether or not this platforms friction value will also apply friction to players.

OVERRIDABLE: This value applies to all shapes in the platform, unless a specific value has been set for a shape

How much friction this shape has. Platforms with higher friction will slow down more when sliding against other platforms.

OVERRIDABLE: This value applies to all shapes in the platform, unless a specific value has been set for a shape

How dense this shape is. Higher density shapes are heavier than lower density shapes of the same size.

OVERRIDABLE: This value applies to all shapes in the platform, unless a specific value has been set for a shape

How fast this or another platform moves after a collision. If two shapes with different bounciness values collide, if both values are positive, the higher bounciness value is used. If one is negative, they are combined, for example 0.8 and -0.5 = 0.3. So in most cases, use a number between -1 and 0 to make this platform less bouncy. Players are 0.95.

OVERRIDABLE: This value applies to all shapes in the platform, unless a specific value has been set for a shape
The angle of this platform, in degrees, clockwise.
The Y position of this body. 0,0 is the center of the stage.
The X position of this body. 0,0 is the center of the stage.

How the physics of this platform behaves.
Stationary: Never moves.
Free moving: Moves and collides with other platforms.
Kinematic: Moves but will never be affected by anything else. They will pass through other kinematic or static bodies. Use the start speed/spin values to make them move.
Use this to select a platform to attach the far end of the rod joint to.
Use this to select a platform to attach the pivot point to.
The X co-ordinate of the point this platform will rotate around. This point is always relative to the position of the platform.
The Y co-ordinate of the point this platform will rotate around. This point is always relative to the position of the platform.
Whether the joint will apply a force to turn the platform.
This will only do anything if Enable Motor is checked. The max speed the motor will accelerate the platform to.
This will only do anything if Enable Motor is checked. The amount of force used to rotate the platform.
Prevent this joint from rotating outside of the specified angles. Make sure you set the from and to angles.
This will only do anything if angle limit is checked. If so, the joint will not be allowed to rotate outside of these two angles.
This will only do anything if Angle Limit is checked. If so, the joint will not be allowed to rotate outside of these two angles.
The X co-ordinate of where on this platform the rod joint attaches to.
The Y co-ordinate of where on this platform the rod joint attaches to.
The X co-ordinate of where the far end of this joint attaches to, where 0,0 is the center.
The Y co-ordinate of where the far end of this joint attaches to, where 0,0 is the center.

How soft this joint is - how much the rod joint is allowed to stretch or compress from its original length. The default is set to 0.1 because some flexibility helps prevent glitches, but use 0 if you want it to be rigid.
This will only do anything if the Softness isn't set to zero. Increasing damping will mean that the platform doesn't bounce forever when the joint is soft.
This checkbox will only do anything if the joints Attach To has been set to another platform. If it is checked, this platform will collide with that platform, if it's not then it wont.
The strength of the spring, how much force it applies to move the platform. If it is too weak it wont be able to hold the platform up.
The default length of the spring. It will stretch longer than this length if the force is too weak to move the platform.
The angle of the path the platform moves along.
How far the platform moves before changing direction.
The speed limit of the platform. If it moves faster than this speed, the move force will be applied to prevent it from moving faster than this speed limit.
How much force is used to accelerate the platform along the path.
Whether or not to draw a line for the joint in game. NOTE: lines are always drawn for joints inside the editor.

If this is set to 0, the joint will never break. If it is set higher than zero, the joint will break if more than that much force is put through it. This force can come from the weight of the platforms themselves, and from collisions.
The X position of the rectangle shape, relative to the center of the platform. If you have rotated your platform, X will no longer be left and right and Y will no longer be up and down.
The Y position of the rectangle shape, relative to the center of the platform. If you have rotated your platform, X will no longer be left and right and Y will no longer be up and down.
The width of the rectangle shape.
The height of the rectangle shape.
The angle of the rectangle shape, relative to the angle of the platform.
The X position of the circle shape, relative to the center of the platform. If you have rotated your platform, X will no longer be left and right and Y will no longer be up and down.
The Y position of the circle shape, relative to the center of the platform. If you have rotated your platform, X will no longer be left and right and Y will no longer be up and down.
The radius of the circle shape.

Whether or not your polygon shape is convex. Polygon shapes must be convex if you want them to have physics. Google concave vs convex if you don't know the difference! The easiest way to remember is that concave shapes have 'caves' in them, convex shapes don't!
The X position of the polygon shape, relative to the center of the platform. If you have rotated your platform, X will no longer be left and right and Y will no longer be up and down.
The Y position of the polygon shape, relative to the center of the platform. If you have rotated your platform, X will no longer be left and right and Y will no longer be up and down.
Use this to rotate the polygon shape, around the center point, set when the shape was created.
Use this to shrink or grow the polygon shape. All the points in the polygon will be scaled from the center point, set when the shape was created.
If this shape is a rectangle or circle, it can shrink gradually.

If inner grapple is enabled, players passing through this shape (because its 'Collide with: players' is off) will be able to initiate a grapple on the edge of the shape from inside it. If it's disabled, they wont.

If no grapple is enabled, players will not be able to grapple it when playing Grapple mode. If no physics is on, you don't need to turn on no grapple as well. If you want to be able to grapple this shape but you don't want players to collide with it, turn off 'Collide with: Players' in Basic Properties and leave 'no grapple' off.

If no physics is enabled, this shape will only be visual, it won't take part in any physics calculations. Use this for scenery and cosmetic details. You should set as many of your shapes as possible to be no-physics, to reduce the lag on your map. Non-convex polygon shapes must be no-physics.
Kills players if they touch it.

How fast this or another shape moves after a collision. If two shapes with different bounciness values collide, if both values are positive, the higher bounciness value is used. If one is negative, they are combined, for example 0.8 and -0.5 = 0.3. So in most cases, use a number between -1 and 0 to make this platform less bouncy. Players are 0.95.

OVERRIDE: This setting will only be applied to this shape, not the whole platform. Set this to blank to use the value for the whole platform, set in basic properties.

How dense this shape is. Higher density shapes are heavier than lower density shapes of the same size.

OVERRIDE: This setting will only be applied to this shape, not the whole platform. Set this to blank to use the value for the whole platform, set in basic properties.

How much friction this shape has. Platforms with higher friction will slow down more when sliding against other platforms.

•Improved FPS and reduced stutter particularly on maps with large numbers of platforms and shapes. If you're still having issues please email bugs@bonk.io with as much info as possible!
•Added gear joints, these are special joints that link two existing joints together. Use them to produce pairs of platforms where one goes up as the other goes down, or a wheel that has to be rotated to make a platform move
•Arrows indicating off screen players are now colored based on the players base color
•In lobby, mode can now be selected without having to cycle through them all

•VTOL gamemode is back and improved
•Added a site mirror, if bonk.io has been blocked, try bonkisback.io
•Grapple quick play map rotation changed to 159 fantastic maps, a massive thanks to everyone who worked on this!
•Added new options for force zones to the editor, they can now push in the direction that the force zone is facing, or apply a push/pull force from the center of the zone
•Fixed 'Fric players: Yes' not working on shapes
•Fixed spawns assigned to no team being drawn in thumbnails
•Fixed 'My Maps' category in the map load window not returning to where you had scrolled to on reopening
•Default map load window category is now Hot
Change your account password here. You can only change one account password every 24 hours.

•Added new physics option to editor: bodies can now behave as force zones that will push other bodies that contact them
•Increased the daily XP limit by 50%
•Fixed a minor graphical bug at the edges of the world when it's blurred

•Merry Christmas!
•Added a background to the lobby showing the map currently selected
•Resizing the lobby now scales the map thumbnail too

•Refreshed the UI a bit
•Added the ability to kick players without banning them
•Arrows quick play map rotation updated

•Updated the classic quick play map rotation, thanks to Oo 0 oO for helping with this. The quickplay matchmaking algorithm is being adjusted over the next few days to place a higher priority on similar skill level and a lower priority on geographical distance.
•Added /roomname, /roompass, and /clearroompass commands to change custom room name and password settings from within the room.
•Added /clear command to clear the chat
•Added ability to change your account password, do it from the settings menu.

•Added Picks category to the Map List. These maps are hand chosen by moderators. Please talk with them about any maps you think deserve to be on the Picks list, and work with them to get your maps good enough for the Picks list!
•Fixed custom game room links not working
•Fixed minor graphical issue with map like bars

•Option to 'end room' when leaving a room you're hosting only shows if there are other players still present.
•Fixed bug in the skin rendering that could cause crashes.
•Improved the main menu appearance.

•Fixed bug where two arrows fired at the same time appear as the same color.
•Added a button to favourite the map currently playing in the main menu replay
•Fixed bug where maps saved with grid sizes with decimal points in them would be rounded, so the grid didn't line up when the map was loaded back into the editor

•Fixed the empty blue player bug, this was also causing desyncs in quick play. 
•Hovering over the replay buttons now hides the brown main menu buttons. 
•Fixed the brown main menu buttons sometimes being hidden after returning from quick play.
•You can now double click rooms in the room list to join them, and hit the enter key after typing in a room password to connect.
Fixed exploit allowing arrows to be invisible.
Fixed the lobby chat sometimes failing to scroll down. When a room host leaves a room, they now have the option to end the room instead of transferring host to someone else.

Small bugfixes and optimisations. Changes to the maps in Arrows Quick Play: removed Trianglezzz by jorray. Added Stone Pillars by Team Arrows Ram, Partition Demolition by Team Arrows Ram, Cliffside by TheRedKirby, Arrow Grounds 2.0 by Ranker_717, and Arrows Warzone #4 by GudStrat.
Replaced Bonk 1: Hot with Bonk 1: Top Rated. Fixed a bug where the map search parameters would be different to what the UI was showing.
Added a report button for replays on the main menu. Minor map editor bugfixes and UI tweaks.

Reworked the grapple physics to be more reliable and consistent. Fixed bugs causing players and capture zones to sometimes but not always block grapples. Added a 'No grapple' option for shapes in the editor, so you can easily set shapes to not be grappleable. The hack of using capture zones set to instant win will still also accomplish this, but you should update any maps to use 'No grapple' instead because this hack may not work in the future. Added an 'inner grapple' option for shapes in the editor, which allows players to grapple the edge of a platform from inside it. Fixed a GPU memory leak when the browser window was resized.
Significant FPS improvements. Fixed map suggestions in custom games not working.

Fixed 'Stay logged in' not working. Fixed issue with Bonk 1: My Maps and Bonk 1: My Favs lists not loading any more maps when you scrolled to the bottom, and with some map results showing up out of order.

RIP Flash :( Migrated to main domain. Fixed scaling issues on some high resolution devices caused by last update. Small bugfixes and improvements to the map editor. Friends list now shows friends from the Flash version of the game, so you can send them friend requests.

Added mode filters to the custom game room list. Improvements to the skin editor, layers can now be any color you like. Dragging with the mouse across the preview with a layer selected will reposition the layer, and scrolling while the mouse is held down will scale the layer. If you also hold the shift key you will rotate the layer. Rooms with friends in them are now sorted by distance. Removed simple game mode. Fixed the game displaying incorrectly on some browsers with high zoom or display scaling settings. More polish to the UI.

Replaced the FPS counter with a more simple one after discovering the old one was actually causing an FPS drop of about 5% itself. Improvements to the tutorial. Tutorial button is now top of the list for guests. Simplified the map load window to only have two categories for Bonk 2 maps - Hot and Death Arrows. The category is determined automatically: the 'For mode' setting in the editor no longer affects which category your map will be shown in. Small editor improvements to the color picker and list of shapes. The type of shape is shown as a C, R or P, and it's shown in light grey if it's no physics. Lobby layout improved slightly.
Added players skins next to each of their messages in the lobby to make keeping track of who's saying what much easier. Fixed arrows in team games not using team colors.
Fixed Simple quick play not working. Fixed death particles in team games not being the correct team colors. Fixed some minor UI bugs.
Fixed bug causing the camera to zoom in at the end of rounds for some players.

Bugs? bugs@bonk.io! FPS improved especially on certain maps. Very large circles in maps may have pixelated edges as a result of the optimisations. Fixed bug causing phantom blue players to appear in quick play. Fixed bug causing players with no score to not show up in the score list in quick play. Fixed bug causing some players to see all skins, and the football pitch, as white. Improved appearance of skins to remove jagged edges. Improved team skins to have clearer colors. In arrows modes, heavy can no longer be used at the same time as drawing an arrow. Improved arrows aiming graphics. VTOL removed.
Grapple quick play released. The map rotation is currently a static rotation of 29 maps, and more will be added after in-game FPS has been improved.

In game chat restyled. Improvements to the lobby: when players minimise the browser or change browser tab their network bar will now turn grey to indicate this. Added a team lock button. Each players ping is now visible under their network bar, in milliseconds (ms). Lower number is better.  Small UI bugfixes and optimisations.

The hot list on the map load window is now separated into 3 categories: General, Grapple, and Death Arrows. Searching will still search all maps. Edits and Fresh have been removed. Added a count for the number of players currently online to the top bar.
Fixed bug causing some in game sounds to play twice. Mid round winner text font changed. Guest names and skin colors are now saved locally.

Editor updated so the dropdown for choosing the mode the map is intended for is more visible. When making a map it's important that you set this and don't just leave it! You can now delete your maps from the level select window, and also remove maps from your favourites list. Added a mute button to the player dropdown menu in the lobby, and added some mouse sounds that were missing.
Map voting now takes place after a game has finished, rather than between rounds. You can also favourite maps from this window, doing this will count as an upvote.

Changed the default level select category from Fresh to Hot. When getting a link to share a custom room, the link is now automatically copied for you. Fixed bug in the editor where renaming a newly created spawn point would actually rename whatever you had selected previously. Fixed bug in the editor causing not all shapes to be deleted when deleting a body, which meant the 'physics shapes' count was incorrect. Any maps that already have this bug will still have it, but the extra shapes that are stuck won't cause any performance slowdown.

UI colors are back to the classic Bonk 1 style. Polished some menu and UI items. Fixed bug causing sounds to distort and eventually stop playing. Fixed bug causing the same replays to sometimes repeat. Custom game search bar removed.

Classic quick play is now the same dynamic map rotation as in Bonk 1. Mid round countdown timer added. Support added for flying maps. Fixed players not being removed from the pitch in football mode when leaving mid game. Fixed bug causing jump to sometimes not work. Fixed bug in some Bonk 1 maps where rotation joints would sometimes be in the wrong position. This fix may have changed some rotation joints in existing Bonk 2 maps, unfortunately this is necessary to make the physics consistent across both versions of the game.

Added platform bounce particles. Changed death particles to be the same colors as the players skin. Added a button in the map editor to instantly test your map in game, with whoever else is in the room. Small visual improvements to the map editor UI. Fixed bug where white borders sometimes appear on the right and bottom edges of backgrounds. Fixed bug where the game would zoom right in at the end of each round.

Tweaked the sounds to allow some distortion and make bounce and collide sounds louder. Changed the high quality graphics option in the settings to instead be low/medium/high. On high the jagged edges that used to appear on some platforms has been fixed. Medium uses a fast anti aliasing method that's not as smooth but is a good compromise. Low has no anti aliasing and should give good framerates on most devices.

Sound volumes increased to be the same as in Bonk 1. Small changes to the movement physics to put them back to how they are in Bonk 1: if you're moving up a slope you'll jump higher, and if you're moving down a slope you wont jump as high. If you're holding X and a direction key you'll change direction slightly slower than you did before. Performance optimisations to reduce frame rate drops and sounds sometimes being delayed. Screen shake increased to be about the same as in Bonk 1, and black bars at the edges of the screen during shake fixed. Max replay length increased to 15 seconds, and introduced a minimum length of 5 seconds.

After each round the winners skin is now shown, and round transition animations have been tidied up. The game window no longer fills the entire screen on large monitors. Background gradient changed to be lighter so it's the same as in the old version of Bonk. Fixed 'player left' messages sometimes not appearing in in-game chat.
By default the space key now activates heavy, and a third set of keyboard controls can be configured. Small improvements to the custom game room list.
Map load window updated to show more map information.
Improved map voting to prompt players to vote in game, and changed to one vote per account.

Fixed skins displaying incorrectly in quick play, and fixed the tutorial not working. Replays now only capture the last 10 seconds up until the record button was pressed, to better highlight great moments rather than full rounds. Increased the power of the boosters on VTOL mode to make flying a bit easier.
More big FPS improvements. Fixed the map load window and editor displaying incorrectly on Firefox.

Large FPS improvements especially when high quality graphics are enabled. Skins look sharper. Colored bands removed in team games, but colored outline thickness increased. Play buttons on main menu scale better. Reduced in game chat to 5 lines to help reduce blocking.

Added a new type of cap zone that is triggered by other physics objects instead of players, and will cause a team to instantly win. These can be used to easily make team based maps where for example getting a ball through a goal wins the round for the team.

Greatly reduced lag, slowdown and memory usage that got progressively worse the longer you had been in game. Grapple Prox is now Grapple, and old Grapple has been removed. Map creators can now mark their maps as designed for a particular mode, and this is shown in the map load window. Added experimental fresh list for Bonk 2 maps.
Network optimisations and improvements. Any bugs: bugs@bonk.io

Menu menu top and bottom bars hide when moving mouse outside the game. Fixed auto login and fetching main menu replays sometimes failing. Fixed friend window opening too large on some low resolution devices.
Streamlined game for new players. New simple game mode added for new players. Fixed map load window opening too large on some low resolution devices.
Added searching for Bonk 2 maps, and adding maps to your favourites. Use /fav or /unfav in lobby or in game.

Mostly fixed the game freezing after returning to it from a different browser tab. Players joining rooms with teams locked now always join as spectators. Fixed lobby chat not scrolling down to the bottom when returning from a game. In game chat opacity and font weight changed to block the game less and be more readable. Commands can be issued from in game chat. Chatting in quick play games resets AFK timer, and timer relaxed to be less strict. Changed mute behaviour so that anyone can mute anyone else, rather than only the host muting someone for the whole room. High quality graphics now defaults to off for ChromeOS devices.
Fixed UI bug on low resolution devices. Fixed lobby and editor being able to be resized beyond the boundaries of the game.
UI redesigned. Music added back in. Lots more polish coming. Added /mute and /unmute commands.

Added ability to publish maps, vote, and hotlist added. A previous update warned not to spend too long on maps because they may get wiped in a future update, this hasn't happened and there's no longer a risk of it. There's going to be some experimentation with the voting and ranking systems, right now you can only thumbs up maps, you can do it multiple times and you are encouraged to do it for maps you repeatedly play. Improved quality of results when searching for maps. Searching is currently only for B1 maps and will be added for B2 maps soon.
Map load window now auto refreshes your own maps when you open it. Publicly releasing and voting on maps is coming soon.
Main menu replays now give credit to the original map creator if it's not an original map. Added a snap grid to the editor, its size can be set in the Map Properties.

Fixed jump height being lower than in Bonk 1, controls may also feel more responsive now. Added a 'complex physics' option to the Map Editor. Added an Anti-Tunnel option for platforms. Added more map size options. Maps now spawn green/yellow team players at green/yellow team spawns, unless the map doesn't have any green/yellow spawns, in which case it will spawn them at red/blue spawns. Fixed lots of editor bugs: joint draw line not being saved, rod joint softness 0 causing crashes, and a crash caused by polygons.

Map editor released. For now you can save maps to your account but not release them publicly, this will come once a better voting/ranking system has been put in place. You can still load/suggest these maps in custom games. There will be bugs, please report them to bugs@bonk.io, along with any thoughts on the editor and new features. Please be aware that at this early stage there's a possibility that any maps you make may be deleted if there are significant changes in the future to the way maps are saved, so please don't spend too long on any masterpieces at this point. You currently have the ability to load anyones maps and save them to your account, though the original map makers credit will be saved with the map too. This is part of a system that will hopefully allow players to make variants/improvements to existing maps, without stealing them or not giving credit.
Fixed bug in todays update causing game lockups and crashes. 1 map removed from arrows quick play.
Added shadows to physical objects and players in game. Fixed death arrows black outline being outside the actual arrow. Fixed chat losing focus when going from in game to lobby. More engine tweaks.
Level editor is very nearly finished! This update makes some minor engine tweaks live so some of the new features of the editor can be tested in public. Expect more updates soon.
Added more maps to arrows picks, and updated arrows quick play to use all of arrows picks. Level editor is coming next, hence the lack of updates.
Tuned some of the game sounds to harmonize with each other and reduced the player death sound volume. Comments bugs@bonk.io

Changed the main menu music to an experimental background drone. The light hearted music didn't really fit the game as well as it did in Bonk 1, and most users had it turned off, so trying a more serious tone. Comments bugs@bonk.io
Added text at the start of each round displaying the game mode, teams configuration and round win limit.
XP is now earned and progress towards your next level shown above the game. Currently 100xp is earned for each round won, this may be adjusted. Added new 'Fresh' maplist to map load window.
Fixed bug with team spawns not working correctly. Reduced time arrows stay on screen from 6 seconds to 5 seconds. Fixed blank screen bug when tabbing out mid game.
Reduced volume of some sounds. More polish. 2 more maps in arrows picks.
When spawning in the same spawn as other players, you're now always drawn on top. Countdown added when starting a game. Added button sounds and general polish.
Added skin manager and skin editor. Friending someone in a custom game lobby now sends them a notification in the chat. Time taken to be kicked for being AFK in a quick play game greatly reduced.
Fixed off screen chirp sound. Added 2 maps to arrows picks. Fixed recording replays in quick play crashing the game. Another skin rendering bug fix. Guests skin color is now randomised.

Added Arrows mode quick play. Improved tutorial. Improved sound handling to prevent crashes and excessively loud sounds. New music added. Reduced the speed at which you can turn your aim in arrows mode from 6 to 5. This makes it easier to make small adjustments, and makes it strategically more important to keep track of which way you and your opponents last fired.

Added options to display FPS, and toggle anti aliasing -  "High quality graphics". The host of a custom room can now choose to make someone else the host, and give up being the host themself, without leaving. If you are scrolled up in the lobby chat, it no longer scrolls down to the bottom every time a message is received. When clicking [Load] on a requested map, the link changes color to show you previously clicked it. The lobby can be visually resized by dragging the bottom right corner.
Fixed a bug causing lag and game crashes.

Fixed 'initial data timeout' bug when joining rooms. Added arrow picks category to the level select window. Made or know any good maps for Arrows? Email bugs@bonk.io and maybe it'll get on the list. Fixed team spawning. Map request chat text visibility improved. Arrows aim assist line slightly longer. Delay before you can fire at the start of an arrows round halved.

Arrow life increased from 3 seconds to 6. Grapple aim assist graphics no longer shown for enemy players. Swapped the add/refresh buttons on the friends window around. More visibility improvements for team skin colors. Arrows now same color as skin base color, or team color if playing teams. Team hits are now always off in team games. Arrows no longer hit friendly players. In arrows mode, added a delay at the start of each round before you can fire. Fixed arrows glitching when they come to a stop. Fixed arrow aim graphics not rotating smoothly.

Ready ding added. Added friend system. Unlike Bonk 1, two players must both agree to be friends before they can see each other in the room list. Due to this your old friends have not been transferred to Bonk 2, but you can send them requests manually. There are some bugs, you can't join anyone in quick play or in a passworded room from the friends window yet. Issues? bugs@bonk.io

Swing renamed to grapple. Added alternate grapple mode, where you will grab on to whatever is closest, in any direction, as opposed to only sideways from your momentum like in regular grapple mode. Comments: bugs@bonk.io

This is the main menu. Click
Quick Play to join a multiplayer game!
Fixed another bug with skins rendering incorrectly. Added profanity filter.

Added ability to customise the controls. They are saved to your account.

Added forward/back/map credits to main menu replays. Fixed skins and the game appearing blurry on high resolution screens with display scaling. Fixed a memory leak that could cause the game to crash. Stars now shown on the news button to show there's news since the last time you played.
'Remember me' functionality added for accounts when logging in/registering.
More skin fixes and bug fixes. Restructured the main menu a bit.

Fixed quick play logging you out. Fixed some skins not rendering in lobby. Fixed some skins rendering incorrectly. If your skin still doesn't look right please email bugs@bonk.io with your account name. Added sound for chat messages. Improved team skins to remove any ambiguity for which team you're on. Performance improvements for skin rendering in lobby.

Skins added. No editor, please use the old one for now. Swing mode improved, you can now only swing for a limited time until you let go. Better visuals to show how much longer you can hold on for. Will be tweaked and balanced. Fixed the game not running on devices that don't support WebGL. Fixed some players not colliding after switching back to FFA from Teams.

Added menu music. Very large physics impacts will now knock you off your grapple in swing mode. When logged in, your maps and your favourites can now be selected from the Level Select window. Bug fixes.

Added background replays to the main menu. Type 'record' into in game chat to record that round and send it to the main menu. Added buttons to join individual teams. Fixed bug where level select window would get stuck open after being kicked.
Teams added. There can now be up to 4 teams, and collisions between friendly players can be turned on or off. Any bugs please email bugs@bonk.io
News window added. Login added. Fixed bug with shrinking platforms not working. Minor usability improvements.
